verdict.rationale: Rootly's API is documented for creating incidents automatically from CI/CD pipelines and other automation systems. It is authenticated with generated global API keys that carry assigned roles. An official MCP server also exposes incident data and actions to headless agent environments such as Claude Code and Gemini CLI. Missing for 10: a dedicated CLI or CI integration (e.g. a pipeline action/plugin), a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes at all candidate paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
